items.title: Cymatics
items.scope: Sound made visible: Chladni plates, Hans Jenny, standing waves. Separate the real physics of nodal patterns from the mystical claims made about them.

items.title: The Eleusinian Mysteries
items.scope: What the sources actually say about Eleusis: the Homeric Hymn to Demeter, the telesterion, the kykeon and the ergot hypothesis (debated). Be clear that what happened inside is not recorded.

items.title: Hilma af Klint & Occult Abstraction
items.scope: Her spiritual practice, The Paintings for the Temple, and the claim that she preceded Kandinsky; Theosophy and Rosicrucian influences. Cite the documented chronology.

items.title: Synchronicity
items.scope: Jung and Pauli, the scarab anecdote, acausal connecting principle; the strongest critiques (apophenia, statistical explanations) stated plainly alongside how practitioners use it.

items.title: Music of the Spheres
items.scope: Pythagorean harmonics, Plato, Boethius, Kepler Harmonices Mundi. Distinguish the ancient doctrine from the modern claims about literal planetary frequencies.

items.title: Labyrinths & Maze Design
items.scope: Cretan, Chartres and Roman patterns; labyrinth vs maze; walking meditation. Build an interactive labyrinth tracer. Do not assert unverified origin claims.

items.title: Gothic Cathedrals & Sacred Light
items.scope: Abbot Suger, Pseudo-Dionysius light theology, rose windows, geometry of builders. Separate documented medieval theology from modern esoteric readings.

items.title: Mandala Construction
items.scope: Tibetan sand mandalas and Hindu yantra geometry as practice, with step-by-step construction geometry and an interactive builder.

items.title: Gregorian Chant & Sacred Sound
items.scope: Modes, neumes, liturgical function, the Guido of Arezzo hexachord; why chant is claimed to induce meditative states and what research says.

items.title: Raga & the Time Theory of Music
items.scope: Raga as mood and hour theory in Indian classical music; the tradition's own cosmology, with an interactive scale/drone explorer.

items.title: The Language of Birds
items.scope: The Green Language / langue des oiseaux tradition: Fulcanelli, Sigurd and the birds in the Völsunga saga, Sufi Mantiq al-Tayr. Present as tradition and wordplay method; note it is not a linguistic claim.

items.title: Asemic Writing & Automatic Script
items.scope: Automatic writing in Spiritualism and Surrealism, Hélène Smith, asemic art; psychological explanations (ideomotor effect) beside practitioner accounts. Include a safe practice.

items.title: Cycles of the Ages: Yugas, Metals & Aeons
items.scope: Hindu yugas, Hesiod's five ages, Zoroastrian cyclic time (Bundahishn); the Precession-of-the-Equinoxes claims and what astronomy does and does not support.

items.title: The Perennial Philosophy
items.scope: Ficino/Steuco, Huxley, Schuon, Traditionalism; the strongest critiques (constructivism, Katz). Trace how the idea itself developed.

items.title: Metaphysics 101
items.scope: Ontology, idealism, dualism, panpsychism, emanation; introduce the vocabulary the rest of the library assumes, from Plato to modern philosophy of mind.

items.title: The Akashic Records
items.scope: Origin in Theosophy (Sinnett, Blavatsky, Steiner, Cayce); the Sanskrit akasha background. State clearly that it is a modern Theosophical construct, not an ancient text.

items.title: Quantum Mysticism: What Physics Does and Does Not Say
items.scope: Observer effect vs measurement, Capra, Zukav, Wigner's friend, Chopra; the misuse of quantum language for manifestation claims. Honest about what is established, debated, and metaphor.

items.title: Kirlian & Aura Photography
items.scope: Semyon Kirlian, coronal discharge, moisture and pressure artifacts, commercial aura cameras; what the images actually show versus aura doctrine.

items.title: Occult Etymology
items.scope: Real etymologies of occult, magic (Magi/Old Persian), mystery, grimoire (grammar), talisman, abracadabra, with folk etymologies and uncertain ones (abracadabra) flagged.

items.title: Göbekli Tepe
items.scope: What excavation (Schmidt, Çelik) shows; the ritual-first hypothesis (debated); how alternative-history claims overreach. Evidence tiers throughout.

items.title: The Library of Alexandria: What Was Lost
items.scope: Documented history (Museion, Callimachus Pinakes), the burnings and decline over centuries, and the myths. Not a single destruction event.

items.title: Delphi & the Oracle Circuit
items.scope: Pythia, the temple of Apollo, ethylene-vent hypothesis (debated), oracle consultation procedure, Dodona and Trophonius.

items.title: Theosophy
items.scope: Blavatsky, Olcott, the Mahatma letters, the Hodgson report, Besant, Leadbeater, Steiner split; influence on modern esotericism. Fair to both its legacy and its controversies.

items.title: Christian Cabala
items.scope: Pico della Mirandola, Reuchlin, Agrippa, Postel, Knorr von Rosenroth; how Renaissance Christians reshaped Jewish Kabbalah.

items.title: Sex Magick: Thelemic and Tantric Currents
items.scope: Historical and doctrinal treatment only: Reuss, Crowley and the O.T.O. degrees, Randolph, and tantric maithuna in its textual context. Non-explicit, scholarly, with consent and ethics emphasised.

items.title: Yoruba, Ifá & the Orishas
items.scope: Respectful overview: Ifá corpus (Odu), Orisha and their diaspora forms; what is open scholarship vs closed initiatory knowledge. Do not reproduce closed material.

items.title: Taoist Inner Alchemy (Neidan)
items.scope: Waidan vs neidan, the Cantong qi, Zhang Boduan, Quanzhen, jing-qi-shen stages; the Secret of the Golden Flower and its translation history.

items.title: Vedanta & the Upanishads
items.scope: Advaita, Vishishtadvaita, Dvaita; mahavakyas such as tat tvam asi; Shankara; how schools disagree. Source references to specific Upanishads.

items.title: Martinism
items.scope: Martinez de Pasqually, Willermoz, Louis-Claude de Saint-Martin, Papus; the Élus Coëns and later orders. Separate documented lineage from claimed lineage.

items.title: Humoral Theory & Elemental Medicine
items.scope: Hippocrates, Galen, four humors and temperaments, how it shaped astrology and herbalism; what it got wrong and what persisted. No medical advice.

items.title: Orgone, Radionics & Fringe Energy
items.scope: Wilhelm Reich, Abrams, Hieronymus machines, the FDA actions; tested claims and results. Present the fringe history without endorsing treatment claims.

items.title: Paracelsus
items.scope: Life, iatrochemistry, tria prima, Archeus, the dose principle; separate the real historical Paracelsus from pseudo-Paracelsian works.

items.title: Flying Ointments & the Pharmacology of Witchcraft
items.scope: Historical sources (della Porta, Weyer), nightshade alkaloids, Piomelli and Pollio's 1994 analysis of reconstructed ointments, and why modern practice is dangerous. No recipes or dosages.

items.title: The Arbatel of Magic
items.scope: 1575 Basel text, its ethical Christian framing, the seven Olympic spirits; compare with Agrippa and later Olympic magic.

items.title: The Sixth and Seventh Books of Moses
items.scope: Johann Scheible's 1849 Stuttgart publication, why the attribution to Moses is false, and its role in Hoodoo and Pow-wow. Describe its provenance only as far as the sources support.

items.title: The Egyptian Book of the Dead
items.scope: Pyramid Texts to Coffin Texts to Papyrus of Ani; the weighing of the heart, Spell 125; the modern title and what the Egyptians called it.

items.title: The Tibetan Book of the Dead (Bardo Thodol)
items.scope: Karma Lingpa terma, the three bardos, Evans-Wentz 1927 title and its Theosophical framing, and the modern scholarly translations.

items.title: Servitors: Building a Magical Assistant
items.scope: Chaos magic and Spare lineage, the thoughtform model, a psychological and a spiritual reading side by side, and a clear process to retire one.

items.title: Atlantis: Source Criticism
items.scope: Plato's Timaeus and Critias, Donnelly 1882, Theosophical Atlantis, and why archaeology finds no such continent. Follow how the story grew.

items.title: The Principia Discordia
items.scope: Malaclypse the Younger and Omar Khayyam Ravenhurst, Kerry Thornley, the Law of Fives, Discordianism as satire and as practice, and Illuminatus! connection.
